_comment: Published 2026/27 South African outfitter pricing (USD) used to anchor the bootstrap training data and to ground the LLM. 'assumed' entries are NOT sourced: they are modelling assumptions that real MikPunt data should overwrite - the training pipeline reports them as such in model_card.json and the API marks the affected answers as low confidence.

sources.video: Published filming quotes: Dirk Pieters Films, HP Productions, Sun Africa Safaris, Africa Wild Productions, iGala Productions, Big Game Hunting Adventures, African Sky Hunting (2025-2026)

dailyRatePerHunterUsd._note: Includes licensed PH, trackers, lodge, all meals, field preparation of trophies, hunting permits. Published: 1x1 = 380 (gaspare) / 500 (bgha) / 435 (asky); 2x1 = 350 (gaspare) / 400 (bgha) / 335 (asky).

observerDailyRateUsd._note: Non-hunter: 280 (bgha), 250 (asky), 170 own room / 116 sharing (gaspare). The ratio to the hunter rate is the portable number.

videographyUsdPerDay.note: Quotes range 300-480/day (median ~380), editing/teaser often included. BGHA: 2,800 for 8 days and 3,850 for 11 days (a flat 350/day, no long-stay discount). African Sky: 480/day.

addOns.note: Gaspare lists return airport transport at 170 per person (min 3 persons); BGHA and African Sky include the Johannesburg transfer in the daily rate.

packagesUsd.note: African Sky all-in packages are priced at a 10% discount on daily rate + trophy fees: 5-day beginner's bushveld 3,915 (1x1) / 3,555 (2x1); 7-day bushveld 9,828 / 9,288; 14-day 14,459 / 13,289; 21-day 24,930 / 23,130. BGHA 8-day buffalo package 16,530 (1x1). Buffalo needs a minimum of 7 hunting days (gaspare).

domestic._note: No published domestic (ZAR, local-hunter) price list could be verified: two Afrikaans lists (Hexrivier Safaris, Ocram Game Farm) were unreachable. The ONLY datapoint is a search-result snippet of ~R1,000 per person per night incl. meals; it is consistent with the platform's own defaults (farm daily rate R850-R1,400, PH standard rate R2,800). Everything in the 'domestic' market segment is therefore ASSUMED and reported as low confidence.

assumed._note: Unsourced assumptions - overwrite with real data.
